preserve.item: 시딩 정의(요청 전 미리 렌더링해 캐시에서 제공)
preserve.evidence: Seeding pre-renders tiles so they are served from the cache instead of being rendered on demand
`--zoom` takes a range of zoom levels.
`--bbox` takes a bounding box in the order `minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat`.

preserve.item: --bbox 생략 시 전체 범위, 전 지구 레이어는 매우 오래 걸림
preserve.evidence: If you omit `--bbox`, the layer's full extent is used, which can take a very long time for global layers.
`geotile seed` uses 4 worker processes by default. Change this with `--workers`.

preserve.item: 600 MB 측정 조건과 벡터 레이어 단서
preserve.evidence: Each worker uses roughly 600 MB of memory. We measured this on our reference setup (raster layers, 256px tiles, PNG output). Vector layers with many features may use considerably more.
Existing tiles are skipped by default. Pass `--force` to overwrite them.
`--force` only re-renders tiles inside the bounding box and does not delete tiles outside it.

Seeding vector layers above zoom 16 is not supported. / Seeding cannot be resumed after interruption yet. ... Already rendered tiles are skipped unless `--force` is set. / It has only been tested with AWS S3, not with S3-compatible services such as MinIO.

must_not.item: 600 MB 측정 조건 또는 벡터 단서 삭제
must_not.evidence: We measured this on our reference setup (raster layers, 256px tiles, PNG output). Vector layers with many features may use considerably more.

must_not.item: --force가 bbox 밖을 지운다고 쓰거나 대조 삭제
must_not.evidence: does not delete tiles outside it.

must_not.item: 재개 기능·MinIO 지원이 있거나 곧 추가된다고 쓰기
must_not.evidence: Seeding cannot be resumed after interruption yet.

must_not.item: 한계 누락 또는 새 한계·옵션 추가
must_not.evidence: Limitations 목록에 원문과 같은 세 항목만 있음
and users don't wait for tiles to load. (원문 'nobody wants to wait for map tiles to load'의 취지 범위 안, 새 수치 없음)

general.evidence: Seeding pre-renders tiles so they are served from the cache instead of being rendered on demand, and users don't wait for tiles to load.
상투적 도입·결론만 삭제되었고 기술 정보는 모두 남음
Each worker uses roughly 600 MB of memory.
The S3 storage backend is experimental for seeding.
Already rendered tiles are skipped unless `--force` is set.
